description: Real-Chrome integration/e2e test files. These launch headless Chrome and are non-deterministic under loaded/serial full-suite runs (Chrome process + tmp-profile leakage causes cumulative resource pressure; verify-breadth-enrichment additionally has an architectural enumerate-gap race documented in tasks/lessons.md 2026-05-24). They are quarantined OUT of `npm test` (the deterministic unit suite that `npm run check` runs) and executed via `npm run test:e2e` (with retries). Convention: add a file here when it launches Chrome (direct createBrowserSession/CDP, demo-driver, or a CLI command that spawns Chrome). See docs/testing.md.
